# Support

| You want to …                     | Go to                                                                                                           |
| --------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| ask a question or share an idea   | the **Discussions** tab of the repository, where enabled; otherwise open an issue                                |
| report a bug                      | a new issue using the **Bug report** form                                                                        |
| propose a feature                 | a new issue using the **Feature request** form                                                                   |
| report a security vulnerability   | the private channels in our [security policy](SECURITY.md), never a public issue                                 |
| get commercial support or consulting | [das-digitale-momentum.de](https://www.das-digitale-momentum.de/en/)                                          |

Our open-source projects are maintained alongside our other work. We read every issue and discussion, but we cannot promise response times.
